text.p: Two law firms said Monday they have filed a securites class action suit in U.S. District Court in Massachusetts against WebSecure Inc, four current or former officers and directors of WebSecure, Centennial Technologies Inc, and Coburn & Meredith Inc and Shamrock Partners Ltd, underwriters for WebSecure's initial public offering in December.

The suit, Nager v. WebSecure Inc was filed on behalf of all persons who purchased common stock or redeemable common stock purchase warrants of WebSecure in the initial public offering or thereafter between Dec 5 and Feb 27.

The complaint alleges that in its IPO WebSecure filed a registration statement that contained false and misleading information and omitted material facts concerning software technology acquired by WebSecure, WebSecure's revenues from the sale of software, and Centennial, which is identified in the registration statement as a related party.
The suit was filed by New York law firm of Wolf Popper LLP and the Boston law firm of Shapiro Haber & Urmy.
Company officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
